name: bash
description: Execute a bash command in the working directory. Output truncated to 5000 lines/100KB; full output saved to a temp file if truncated.

name: read
description: Read a file's contents. Supports text and images (jpg/png/gif/webp/bmp). Text output truncated to 5000 lines/100KB; use offset to continue.

name: write
description: Write content to a file, creating it and parent dirs if needed, overwriting if it exists.

name: edit
description: Edit a file via exact text replacement. Each edits[].oldText must be unique and non-overlapping in the file; merge nearby changes into one edit.

edits.description: Targeted replacements, matched against the original file

name: find
description: Find files by glob pattern, relative to search dir. Respects .gitignore. Truncated to 1000 results/100KB.

name: grep
description: Search file contents by pattern (regex or literal). Respects .gitignore. Truncated to 100 matches/100KB; lines truncated to 2000 chars.

literal.description: Treat pattern as literal string, default false

context.description: Lines of context around match, default 0

name: ls
description: List directory contents, sorted alphabetically; dirs suffixed with '/'. Truncated to 500 entries/100KB.
